```sql

FROM aircraft a
JOIN aircraft_types at ON a.type_id = at.type_id
WHERE a.status = 'active'
AND a.aircraft_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT aircraft_id
    FROM flights
    WHERE status = 'completed'
)
AND a.aircraft_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT aircraft_id
    FROM maintenance_records
    WHERE is_aog = 1
)
AND a.aircraft_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT aircraft_id
    FROM fuel_uplifts
    WHERE total_cost_usd > 0
);
```
